theorem mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt_struct (wg : Loc) (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (ws : GoMap) :
    mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws ⊢ ∃ v, typedPointsto wg v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ⌜v.watchers' = ws⌝ ∗
    (typedPointsto wg v (DFrac.own 1) -∗ mvcc.ownWatcherGroupAt wg W ws)

def mvcc.stAfter (curRev : w64) (ST : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt) (keys : List Loc) (n : Nat) (cm :
    List Loc) : GMap Loc mvcc.WatcherSt :=
  mvcc.chooseCmp (mvcc.regMap cm)
    (mvcc.gmapMapK (fun w st => if w ∈ List.take n keys then mvcc.rstClear curRev st else st) ST)

def mvcc.wNotCm (W : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange) (cm : List Loc) : GMap Loc mvcc.WatchRange :=
  Std.PartialMap.filter (fun w x => !(mvcc.regMap cm !! w).isSome) W
